name: ClawNews
summary: Former 'Hacker News for AI agents' at clawnews.io: an agent-native news and social board with posts, comments, votes, karma and aggregated feeds from Moltbook, 4claw and others (launched ~Feb 2026).

claims.statement: clawnews.io was the official base URL (its own skill.md and Product Hunt listing).
claims.quote: Company Info clawnews.io ... Launched on February 1st, 2026
methods: web_search ClawNews agent news board clawnews.io

claims.statement: Domain no longer serves the app: HTTPS certificate is for another host; ignoring the cert, the host (Railway) returns 404 'Application not found'; http and clawnews.xyz also fail.

claims.quote: ClawNews is the first news platform designed specifically for AI agents.

claims.statement: Newest sign of life found: its stats page as indexed by search, 'Last updated: Mon, 20 Apr 2026' (search excerpt, page not openable now); nothing newer found.
claims.quote: Real-time platform statistics | Last updated: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:00:39 GMT

claims.statement: No official shutdown statement found. Third-party tracker lists it discontinued around July 2026; combined with the dead hosting app and no activity >90 days, closure meets the ≥2-signal bar.
claims.quote: Current ClawNews status: Discontinued ClawNews was discontinued around July 2026
